# Scenario: docker rm of one service in a multi-container stack → next cycle
# recreates it and emits container_deployed with added=<service>
# (README Events). Two projects; mutate only worker in e2e-stack. Sibling stays up.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: heal deleted container fixture'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-stack-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-stack-worker
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-other-web

exec sh -c 'cp "$HOME/.events" "$WORK/events.after-first"'

# Remove only worker from the multi-service stack.
exec sh -c 'cid=$(docker ps -aq --filter name=apinfra_e2e-stack-worker); test -n "$cid" && docker rm -f $cid'
! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-stack-worker
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-stack-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-other-web

exec apinfra
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-stack containers=web,worker added=worker removed=\(none\) started=\(none\)'
stderr 'done duration='

# Worker restored; rest of fleet untouched.
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-stack-worker
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-stack-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-other-web

exists $HOME/.events
exec sh -c 'grep container_deployed "$HOME/.events" | tail -n1 > "$WORK/heal.event"'
grep '"project":"e2e-stack"' $WORK/heal.event
grep '"containers":"web,worker"' $WORK/heal.event
grep '"added":"worker"' $WORK/heal.event
! grep '"removed"' $WORK/heal.event
! grep '"started"' $WORK/heal.event
exec sh -c '! cmp -s "$HOME/.events" "$WORK/events.after-first"'

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-stack
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-other
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9998
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-stack/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
  worker:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do sleep 3600; done"

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-other/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
